title: Nodes
description: Every cluster node at once, ranked worst first; click a node, or pick one in the dropdown, to see it alone and pod by pod. Replaces the vendored Kubernetes / Views / Nodes (grafana.com 15759), which showed one node at a time and filtered on a `cluster` label no series carries. docs/design/observability.md.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Nodes selected.

panels.title: Not ready
panels.description: Nodes whose Ready condition is false or unknown.

panels.title: Under pressure
panels.description: Nodes reporting memory, disk or PID pressure.

targets.expr: count(sum by (exported_node) (kube_node_status_condition{exported_node=~"$node", condition=~".+Pressure", status="true"}) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Cordoned
panels.description: Nodes marked unschedulable.

panels.title: Pods running
panels.description: Pods in phase Running on the selected nodes.

panels.title: CPU used
panels.description: CPU the selected nodes use (node-exporter, idle, iowait and steal excluded) as a share of what they can allocate to pods.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (node) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node", mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum(max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_status_allocatable{exported_node=~"$node", resource="cpu"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)")))

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Memory in use (total less available) as a share of what the selected nodes can allocate to pods.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (node) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node"})) / sum(max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_status_allocatable{exported_node=~"$node", resource="memory"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)")))

panels.title: OOM kills, 24 h
panels.description: Kernel OOM kills on the selected nodes in the last 24 hours, any process.

panels.title: Nodes, worst first
panels.description: One row per selected node: not ready first, then the most pressure conditions, then the fullest memory. Used and requested are shares of what the node can allocate to pods. The physical host is the NUC a VM runs on (from Proxmox) or the Pi itself. Click a node to see it alone, or its host to open the host's dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (node, host) (label_replace(label_replace(pve_guest_info{name=~"k8s-.*", name=~"$node"}, "host", "$1", "node", "(.+)"), "node", "$1", "name", "(.+)")) or max by (node, host) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_node_info{exported_node=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"), "host", "$1", "exported_node", "(.+)")) unless on (node) max by (node, host) (label_replace(label_replace(pve_guest_info{name=~"k8s-.*", name=~"$node"}, "host", "$1", "node", "(.+)"), "node", "$1", "name", "(.+)"))

max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_role{exported_node=~"$node", role="control-plane"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)")) or on (node) 0 * max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_info{exported_node=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"))

sum by (node) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node", mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[$__rate_interval])) / max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_status_allocatable{exported_node=~"$node", resource="cpu"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"))

sum by (node) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{exported_node=~"$node", resource="cpu"} * on (exported_namespace, exported_pod) group_left () (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"} == 1), "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)")) / max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_status_allocatable{exported_node=~"$node", resource="cpu"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)")) or 0 * max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_info{exported_node=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"))

sum by (node) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node"}) / max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_status_allocatable{exported_node=~"$node", resource="memory"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"))

sum by (node) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{exported_node=~"$node", resource="memory"} * on (exported_namespace, exported_pod) group_left () (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"} == 1), "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)")) / max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_status_allocatable{exported_node=~"$node", resource="memory"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)")) or 0 * max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_info{exported_node=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"))

count by (node) (label_replace(kube_pod_info{exported_node=~"$node"} * on (exported_namespace, exported_pod) group_left () (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1), "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)")) or 0 * max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_info{exported_node=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"))

round(sum by (node) (increase(node_vmstat_oom_kill{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node"}[24h]))) or 0 * max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_info{exported_node=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"))

panels.title: CPU used
panels.description: CPU each node uses as a share of what it can allocate to pods.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node", mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[$__rate_interval])) / max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_status_allocatable{exported_node=~"$node", resource="cpu"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Memory each node has in use (total less available) as a share of what it can allocate to pods.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node"}) / max by (node) (label_replace(kube_node_status_allocatable{exported_node=~"$node", resource="memory"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: Cores the containers use, per node, or per pod when one node is chosen.

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: Container working set, per node, or per pod when one node is chosen.

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: Five-minute load average over the node's core count. Above 1 means runnable work is queueing.

targets.expr: max by (node) (node_load5{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node"}) / count by (node) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node", mode="idle"})

panels.title: OOM kills
panels.description: Kernel OOM kills per interval, any process on the node. Reads None while nothing is killed.

panels.title: CPU stall
panels.description: Share of time at least one task waits on CPU (PSI "some").

panels.title: Memory stall
panels.description: Share of time at least one task waits on memory (PSI "some").

panels.title: IO stall
panels.description: Share of time at least one task waits on IO (PSI "some").

panels.title: Node conditions
panels.description: Each node condition while it is true: memory, disk or PID pressure, or network unavailable. Reads None while no node reports one.

panels.title: Nodes not ready
panels.description: Each node while its Ready condition is not true. Reads None while every node is Ready.

panels.title: Pods on the selected nodes
panels.description: Every pod scheduled on the selected nodes, most restarts first, then the most memory. Click a pod, namespace or node to open it.

targets.expr: (sum by (node, namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{node=~"$node", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (node, namespace, pod) max by (node, namespace, pod) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_pod_info{exported_node=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "exported_pod", "(.*)"))) or 0 * max by (node, namespace, pod) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_pod_info{exported_node=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "exported_pod", "(.*)"))

(sum by (node, namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{node=~"$node", container!="", container!="POD"}) and on (node, namespace, pod) max by (node, namespace, pod) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_pod_info{exported_node=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "exported_pod", "(.*)"))) or 0 * max by (node, namespace, pod) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_pod_info{exported_node=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "exported_pod", "(.*)"))

round(sum by (node, namespace, pod) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[24h]) * on (exported_namespace, exported_pod) group_left (exported_node) kube_pod_info{exported_node=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "exported_pod", "(.*)"))) or 0 * max by (node, namespace, pod) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_pod_info{exported_node=~"$node"}, "node", "$1", "exported_node", "(.*)"), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "exported_pod", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Bits per second each node sends (above zero) and receives (below zero) on its physical interface.

panels.title: Errors and drops
panels.description: Packets per second the physical interface fails or drops, both directions. Reads None while there are none.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node", device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node", device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

sum by (node) (rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node", device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(node_network_transmit_drop_total{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node", device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: TCP connections
panels.description: Established TCP connections on each node.

panels.title: Conntrack table used
panels.description: Connection-tracking entries as a share of the table's limit. A full table drops new connections.

panels.title: EPHEMERAL used
panels.description: Share of each node's EPHEMERAL partition (/var) in use: container images, logs, emptyDirs and Longhorn replicas.

targets.expr: 1 - max by (node) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node", mountpoint="/var"}) / max by (node) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", node=~"$node", mountpoint="/var"})

panels.title: System disk
panels.description: Bytes per second written to (above zero) and read from (below zero) the node's own disk, `sda`. Longhorn volumes attached over iSCSI are other devices and are left out.

panels.title: Volumes used
panels.description: Share of each persistent volume claim mounted on the selected nodes in use (kubelet volume stats).

targets.expr: max by (node, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{node=~"$node"}) / max by (node, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Machine logs
panels.description: Talos machine and kernel logs of the selected nodes (`job="talos"`).
